answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can price identity with a time-locked work bond: each agent locks funds and earns weight only after many epochs of useful, verified work, so a fresh fake identity starts at zero and must pay the full time cost before it can vote or earn. A public randomness beacon then picks a small random sample of identities each epoch for a deep audit, like cracking a walnut to check the kernel inside, and any identity caught faking loses its bond and its history, so the pearl of accumulated reputation is worth more kept honest than sold to a Sybil farm.
